Calculate total fertility rates

Source: R/calc_demographic_measures.R
calculate_tfr.Rd

Sum age-specific fertility rates times their actual interval widths. If parity-bound columns are present, delegate to calculate_patfr() instead and return its patfr column rather than tfr, with the same other strata. Open-ended age bands are omitted, warning if an omitted female rate is known and nonzero that TFR underestimates fertility over the full age range. Zero or missing omitted rates do not trigger that warning. The remaining finite, contiguous age range defines the TFR reported. Any missing ASFR in those bands makes the TFR missing. When union_type (or a legacy union_status column) is present, calculate a separate sum for each stratum within each period. These conditional sums describe fertility under continuous exposure to that status; they are not components to add into an overall TFR. A group column automatically adds separate group strata, with its type and labels preserved; groups are not pooled. Age bands are checked independently within each period/group/status combination.

Usage

calculate_tfr(rates)

Arguments

rates

A table returned by calculate_fertility_rates(), a fertility process object, or a data frame with age_start, age_end, and rate_fertility or rate in births per woman-year. Bare rate tables are interpreted as fertility rates; mortality processes are not valid inputs.

Value

With parity columns, the result of calculate_patfr() with patfr. Otherwise, a tibble with period columns, union_type or legacy union_status when supplied, group when supplied, age_start, age_end, and tfr. If sex is present, only female rows are used.
